mapper.sql: o.id, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.member_id AS memberId, o.member_name AS memberName, o.member_mobile AS memberMobile, o.product_id AS productId, o.product_name AS productName, o.product_type_name AS productTypeName, o.service_type AS serviceType, o.store_id AS storeId, s.storeName AS storeName, o.lesson_count AS lessonCount, o.duration_minutes AS durationMinutes, o.validity_days AS validityDays, o.benefit_vip_card_id AS benefitVipCardId, vc.card_name AS benefitCardName, o.benefit_price AS benefitPrice, o.original_amount AS originalAmount, o.payable_amount AS payableAmount, o.paid_amount AS paidAmount, o.refund_amount AS refundAmount, o.discount_amount AS discountAmount, o.marketing_type AS marketingType, o.marketing_activity_name AS marketingActivityName, o.coupon_name AS couponName, o.coupon_discount_amount AS couponDiscountAmount, o.pay_method AS payMethod, o.pay_status AS payStatus, o.order_status AS orderStatus, o.order_source AS orderSource, o.source_order_id AS sourceOrderId, o.source_benefit_id AS sourceBenefitId, o.remark AS remark, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(g.lesson_count), 0) FROM pt_private_order g WHERE g.source_order_id = o.id AND g.order_source = 1 AND g.deleted = 0) AS giftedLessons, b.id AS benefitId, b.benefit_no AS benefitNo, b.total_lessons AS totalLessons, b.used_lessons AS usedLessons, b.frozen_lessons AS frozenLessons, b.remaining_lessons AS remainingLessons, b.status AS benefitStatus, DATE_FORMAT(b.expire_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS expireAt, DATE_FORMAT(o.paid_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS paidAt, DATE_FORMAT(o.settled_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS settledAt, DATE_FORMAT(o.cancel_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS cancelAt, DATE_FORMAT(o.refund_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS refundAt, DATE_FORMAT(o.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) AS orderCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN o.pay_status IN (1, 2, 3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS paidOrderCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN o.pay_status IN (1, 2, 3) THEN IFNULL(o.paid_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS paidAmount, IFNULL(SUM(IFNULL(o.refund_amount, 0)), 0) AS refundAmount FROM pt_private_order o

SELECT FROM pt_private_order o LEFT JOIN store_address s ON s.storeAddrId = o.store_id LEFT JOIN vip_benefit_card vc ON vc.vip_card_id = o.benefit_vip_card_id LEFT JOIN pt_member_private_benefit b ON b.order_id = o.id WHERE o.id = #{id} AND o.deleted = 0
AND o.store_id IN (${storeIds})
LIMIT 1

SELECT id, order_id AS orderId, coupon_id AS couponId, member_coupon_id AS memberCouponId, coupon_name AS couponName, coupon_type AS couponType, discount_amount AS discountAmount, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM pt_private_order_coupon_rel WHERE order_id = #{orderId} LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM pt_private_order o WHERE o.id = #{id} AND o.deleted = 0
AND o.store_id IN (${storeIds})

SELECT u.userId AS id, u.nickname AS name, u.phone AS mobile, u.nowStoreId AS storeId, sa.storeName FROM user_info u LEFT JOIN store_address sa ON sa.storeAddrId = u.nowStoreId WHERE u.isDel = 0 AND (CAST(u.userId AS CHAR) LIKE concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.nickname LIKE concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.phone LIKE concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND u.nowStoreId IN (${storeIds})
ORDER BY u.createdDate DESC, u.userId DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT p.id, p.product_name AS productName, p.sale_price AS salePrice, p.lesson_count AS lessonCount, p.duration_minutes AS durationMinutes, p.validity_days AS validityDays, p.service_type AS serviceType FROM pt_product p WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.listing_status = 1 AND (p.listing_at IS NULL OR p.listing_at <= NOW()) AND (p.unlisting_at IS NULL OR p.unlisting_at > NOW()) AND (#{keyword} IS NULL OR #{keyword} = '' OR CAST(p.id AS CHAR) LIKE concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.product_name LIKE concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pt_product_store_rel r WHERE r.product_id = p.id AND r.store_id = #{storeId})
AND #{storeId} IN (${storeIds})
ORDER BY p.sort_no DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT c.id, c.coach_name AS coachName, c.mobile FROM pt_coach c INNER JOIN pt_coach_store_rel csr ON csr.coach_id = c.id AND csr.store_id = #{storeId} WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.status = 1 AND (#{keyword} IS NULL OR #{keyword} = '' OR CAST(c.id AS CHAR) LIKE concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.coach_name LIKE concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.mobile LIKE concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')) AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pt_product_coach_rel pcr WHERE pcr.product_id = #{productId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pt_product_coach_rel pcr WHERE pcr.product_id = #{productId} AND pcr.coach_id = c.id))
AND #{storeId} IN (${storeIds})
ORDER BY c.sort_no DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT u.userId AS id, u.nickname AS name, u.phone AS mobile, u.nowStoreId AS storeId FROM user_info u WHERE u.userId = #{memberId} AND u.isDel = 0
AND u.nowStoreId IN (${storeIds})
LIMIT 1

SELECT p.id, p.product_name AS productName, p.product_type_id AS productTypeId, (SELECT type_name FROM pt_product_type WHERE id = p.product_type_id) AS typeName, p.service_type AS serviceType, p.sale_price AS salePrice, p.lesson_count AS lessonCount, p.duration_minutes AS durationMinutes, p.validity_days AS validityDays, p.sale_stock AS saleStock, p.sold_count AS soldCount FROM pt_product p WHERE p.id = #{productId} AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.listing_status = 1 AND (p.listing_at IS NULL OR p.listing_at <= NOW()) AND (p.unlisting_at IS NULL OR p.unlisting_at > NOW()) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pt_product_store_rel r WHERE r.product_id = p.id AND r.store_id = #{storeId})
AND #{storeId} IN (${storeIds})
LIMIT 1

SELECT MIN(c.id) FROM pt_coach c INNER JOIN pt_coach_store_rel csr ON csr.coach_id = c.id AND csr.store_id = #{storeId} INNER JOIN pt_product_coach_rel pcr ON pcr.coach_id = c.id AND pcr.product_id = #{productId} WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.status = 1 HAVING COUNT(*) = 1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pt_coach c INNER JOIN pt_coach_store_rel csr ON csr.coach_id = c.id AND csr.store_id = #{storeId} WHERE c.id = #{coachId} AND c.deleted = 0 AND c.status = 1 AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pt_product_coach_rel pcr WHERE pcr.product_id = #{productId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pt_product_coach_rel pcr WHERE pcr.product_id = #{productId} AND pcr.coach_id = c.id))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pt_private_order (order_no, member_id, member_name, member_mobile, product_id, product_name, product_type_id, product_type_name, service_type, store_id, coach_id, lesson_count, duration_minutes, validity_days, original_amount, payable_amount, paid_amount, refund_amount, discount_amount, marketing_type, coupon_discount_amount, pay_method, pay_status, order_status, order_source, remark, paid_at, settled_at, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{memberId}, #{memberName}, #{memberMobile}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{productTypeId}, #{productTypeName}, #{serviceType}, #{storeId}, #{coachId}, #{lessonCount}, #{durationMinutes}, #{validityDays}, #{originalAmount}, #{payableAmount}, #{paidAmount}, 0, 0, 0, 0, 9, 2, 2, 0, #{remark}, NOW(), NOW(), #{createdBy}, NOW(), #{updatedBy}, NOW(), 0)

SELECT FROM pt_private_order o WHERE o.id = #{id} AND o.deleted = 0
AND o.store_id IN (${storeIds})
LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM pt_private_order o WHERE o.source_order_id = #{sourceOrderId} AND o.order_source = 1 AND o.deleted = 0 ORDER BY o.id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE pt_member_private_benefit SET total_lessons = total_lessons + #{lessonCount}, remaining_lessons = remaining_lessons + #{lessonCount}, status = CASE WHEN expire_at IS NOT NULL AND expire_at <= NOW() THEN 3 ELSE 1 END WHERE id = #{benefitId}

mapper.update: UPDATE mk_member_coupon SET use_status = CASE WHEN expire_time <= NOW() THEN 2 ELSE 0 END, used_order_id = NULL, used_time = NULL WHERE used_order_id = #{orderId}
